decisions.reason: The black-finish range went from a website mention to a page of its own in 2024, a sign of growing commitment. As a finish variant of existing drains it costs little to keep, and its prospects in the black-bathroom design trend are still resolving, so the option stays open.

The shower channel for seamless coverings has had its own page in both years and fits the firm's core barrier-free, design-led strategy. The results so far support keeping it and investing further rather than abandoning it.

The pump-drain shower channel launched only in 2024 and its uncertainty is still high, so management keeps it open for now. The quick withdrawal of the earlier pump solution (C) shows the firm will cut pump products that fail to perform, which adds some risk.
